Customer Success Specialist
Example Company

We are looking for a Customer Success Specialist to support small business customers.

Responsibilities
Communicate clearly with customers over email and scheduled calls.
Coordinate onboarding, investigate account issues, and escalate technical problems.
Work with the product team to identify recurring feedback and improve the customer experience.
Keep accurate records and develop helpful support documentation.

Requirements
Experience in customer service or customer success.
Strong written communication and problem-solving skills.
Comfort working with spreadsheets and CRM tools.
Ability to prioritize work and collaborate with colleagues.

Interview process
A recruiter conversation followed by a practical customer scenario and a team interview.
